title: Addressed continuation preservation in the native TypedLoop cell

scope.architecture: Freshly trained native TypedLoop cell with a declared streaming preview adapter; the original ProofPolicy wrapper and LR-01 checkpoints are not reused.
scope.baseline: AF-01 GRU architecture trained on the identical augmented input set and optimization schedule. Parameters, boundary bits, and arithmetic differ and are reported.
scope.interpretation: Public graph routing supplies branch addresses. Experiments test whether recurrence retains and uses that supplied binding. Both preview orders occur during training.
scope.proof: The neural task is preview memory and candidate selection. Host Horn chains and Lean certificates keep the original theorem fixed; chain depth is public metadata.
scope.reversal: The Jacobian diagnostic measures local perturbation recovery around a retained reference state. It does not assert a globally invertible TypedLoop.

data.features: AF-01 F9. P carries one public receipt. G is the goal marker. W is [0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,depth/8]. No hidden facts, proof terms, case IDs, future schedule, total length, or target labels enter the recurrence.
data.weighting: Fit once per canonical input; sample canonical inputs uniformly. Score every metric equally over distinct full input sequences, retaining host-copy counts separately. Weight intervention semantic accuracy by distinct composed histories.
data.padding: Group sampled rows by their actual sequence length and weight bucket losses by their sampled row counts. Padding executes no writer, recurrence, or codec.
data.split_integrity: Freeze exact input and host manifests before training. Assert pairwise disjoint canonical feature-hash sets. Dev is eligibility-only with fixed final checkpoints.
data.host_contract: Original theorem target uses AF-01 hash schema. A separate AF02 context digest binds target, case/renaming identity, candidate traces, statuses, order, depth, schedule, and budget.
data.budget: 3 + number of W events. Each P and W costs one action; G costs zero; submit/STOP costs the final action.
data.task_target: Smallest valid branch, else STOP; legitimate completion also accepts the other valid branch. Tainted attempts, dead rejects, and false host acceptance are separate.

gru.implementation: Reuse AF-01 GRUCell and task/audit heads exactly.

native.cell: Import TypedLoop verbatim from pinned native source; verify the full native source and dependency hashes.
native.graph: Two declared rules A0->Goal and A1->Goal; physical layout is supplied public structure.
native.writer: Separate affine F9->16 atom/rule writers. Zero the two address coordinates in the payload. At each visit, inject payload then execute the native cell. Addressed P writes its atom and rule; W/G write the goal atom. An address-erased P writes the goal atom only.
native.heads: Shared branch feature [Rj,Goal,Aj]; shared branch linear score receives appended public rank j; STOP linear reads [Goal,mean(A0,A1),mean(R0,R1)]; shared linear audit predicts three statuses per branch.
native.codec: Separate atom and rule affine16to4+tanh/affine4to16 codecs, shared within type.

model.insertion: Codec after every recurrent call, including each W and G visit. Store actual pre-decoder code and decoded carry. Next computation consumes decoded carry.
model.initialization: Identical task/joint codec initialization from train-only PCA, separately by native node type. Equal weight per canonical input, then per visit and token within type. Encoder basis scaled0.5, decoder basis scaled2, train mean retained.
model.common_codec_loss: task CE + 0.25 KL from frozen teacher task logits
model.joint_extra_loss: 0.5 decoded one-step commutation MSE + 0.25 donor continuation task CE + 0.5 audit CE + 0.25 donor continuation audit CE
model.commutation: For each native teacher prefix h and current event e, compare decode(encode(U_e(decode(encode(h))))) to stopgrad(decode(encode(U_e(h)))); average visits within each input, then inputs.
model.donor_training: Permute within first branch/depth/schedule strata. Both codec arms consume the same minibatch and donor RNG stream. Teacher weights remain frozen.
model.checkpoint_selection: Fixed final steps. No restart based on measured performance. Any incomplete engineering run is retained and labeled.
model.exports: 18 .pt checkpoints and matching18 named-array .npz exports: architecture_{teacher|task|joint}_s{seed}. Source and codec parameters remain separate. Retain all2592 canonical train/dev prediction rows and raw logits.
model.eligibility: For each architecture/seed, task accuracy and each branch audit accuracy must each reach0.95 separately in both probe orders on both train and dev.

evaluation.inference: Raw task argmax with no host legality mask. Host checking accepts/rejects afterward. Retain raw logits and predictions; masked logits are inapplicable.
evaluation.exact_binding: Payload-fixed address companions swap both status assignment and order. Both-member task correctness is scored on exactly-one-valid pairs; audit permutation on unequal-status pairs. Keep consistency and correctness separate.
evaluation.address_erasure: Zero both F9 address coordinates; native routing then sends every P to the goal atom only. Score against unchanged original host targets. Enumerate finite ceilings before fitting.
evaluation.graph_permutations: All12 physical permutations of3atom and2rule slots, moving incidence, routing and output interpretation consistently. Native clean arms only. Compare every canonical input's worst logit discrepancy; no learned generalization claim.
evaluation.timing: One warm-up, then one timed block of three forwards per actual-length bucket; report batch-average time separately from fitting, environment and Lean.
evaluation.resources: Count source, codec and writer/head matrices, all real visits, all stored parameters/buffers, code bits and decoded working coordinates. Nonlinearities, indexing, framework and verifier work are outside dense MAC estimates. No compute-gain hypothesis for codec insertion.

interventions.boundary: After the second visit of the first actual P; resume the recipient's remaining events.
interventions.deduplication: One donor per distinct observed prefix hash; three prefixes per stratum.
interventions.patch: Patch at the actual carried-code boundary, then decode once. With no codec, the carried code is the full state. Addressed/other pairs each select the corresponding atom and rule; goal_only selects the goal atom.
interventions.scope: Counterfactual targets come from composed public histories. These records earn no proof or attack credit against the original recipient theorem.
interventions.weighting: Whole-state semantic results deduplicate composed input hashes. Localization effects use the exhaustive changed-prefix pair roster and report donor/recipient counts and patch norms.
interventions.retain: Store prefix references, token masks, actual patched codes, resumed traces, raw logits, composed targets and direct hybrid replay outputs.

hypotheses.protected_benefit: Within each architecture and eligible seed on depth_context, joint minus task audit-exact accuracy >=0.05; joint task accuracy >= task-0.02; no extra tainted attempts. Every registered seed must pass for an overall positive claim.
hypotheses.delayed_preservation: Within each architecture and eligible seed, every heldout family requires joint task accuracy >= teacher-0.02, joint audit-exact >=0.95, and no extra tainted attempts. Source clean audit must also reach0.95 in that family; otherwise that family's preservation claim is inconclusive.
hypotheses.addressed_causal_preservation: Native only, depth_context changed-prefix pairs. Teacher clean audit >=0.95 and addressed-pair minus other-pair first-branch target accuracy >=0.20 define an informative source. Joint must preserve addressed-pair first-branch target accuracy, recipient-other-branch accuracy, and selectivity gap within0.05 of that source. Source eligibility also required. An insensitive/failed source yields inconclusive.
hypotheses.binding_repair: Descriptive per-order correctness and payload-fixed address companion results; compare the both-order GRU and native source with their own resource counts. No architecture superiority claim from equal optimization steps.
hypotheses.aggregation: A failed eligible/qualified required stratum makes an aggregate fail; all required strata passing makes pass; otherwise inconclusive. Retain all scored outcomes.
hypotheses.engineering: Source/artifact integrity, exact roster coverage, independent numerical replay, semantic oracle arithmetic, actual Lean checks, and inverse-control tolerances gate execution. Failed scientific hypotheses do not fail CI.

inverse.contexts: 18 canonical depth_context cases with depth4 and schedulePPG: all status pairs and both orders.
inverse.reference: Float32 carried state after the two P events (visit index3), lifted to float64. F is one G visit: learned G writer plus native TypedLoop.
inverse.precision: float64 copy of frozen float32 source weights
inverse.tangent: Block mean-zero tangent orthogonal to 1/gamma for each of3atom and2rule tokens. Width75 when all absolute gains >=1e-8; record degeneracy otherwise.
inverse.amplitude_scope: Absolute L2 perturbation norm in the full state.
inverse.rng: NumPy PCG64 seed from first8 SHA256 bytes, little-endian, of 'af02-inverse-v1:{seed}:{public_input_sha256}'. Reuse directions across horizons and amplitudes.
inverse.recovery: B=Qout^T J Qin. delta_hat=Qin pinv(B) Qout^T [F^q(h+delta)-F^q(h)]. Retain full predecessor error including discarded directions.
inverse.retained: Reference, exact events, both bases, full ambient Jacobian, tangent singular values, perturbations, recovered displacement, baseline/target/return outputs and pre-LN gauge controls.
inverse.judgment: Descriptive local recovery; numerical validation gates only. Small forward-return error alone does not establish recovery of the predecessor.

retained_after_scoring: counterfactual patched codes and resumed traces
artifacts.failure_policy: Preserve every attempted run and explain engineering fixes. Scored AF02 outcomes never tune weights, steps, objectives, cutoffs or thresholds. Any subsequent scientific revision receives a new registration.
